اسحنككوا (form XIV)
# اِسْحَنْكَكُوا (isḥankakū) /is.ħan.ka.kuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
# اِسْحَنْكِكُوا (isḥankikū) /is.ħan.ki.kuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْحَنْكَكَ (isḥankaka)
